Subject: Pen test ask: scope clarification + asset list request

Hi Rachel,

We're preparing a scoping packet for an external penetration scan (financial services profile) and need a short attack-surface summary, list of assets in-scope (hosts, APIs, third-party integrations), and a point of contact for remediation. Redpoint Security will run the scan next month; they asked for evidence locations (logs, config backups, app inventories) so they can scope the work and provide a formal quote.

Can Redwood provide:
- a 1-page attack-surface summary (public endpoints, internal admin panels, third-party connections),
- S3/location for application logs and retention windows,
- names/emails of remediation owners (primary + backup),
- preferred SLAs for remediation windows for critical/high findings.

We need this by next Tuesday (2026-12-09) to meet procurement. Let me know if you want a call; VoltBank's security manager (Laila) is available Monday morning.

Thanks,
Laila Rao
VoltBank SOC

Thanks Rachel — I'll take the lead on the attack-surface summary and the compliance artifacts we can share. A few clarifying points from Security:

1) Scope definition: Redpoint asked for "public endpoints + admin consoles + partner integrations." We should explicitly exclude internal developer laptops and ephemeral CI containers; those are out-of-scope unless VoltBank requests broader coverage.
2) Evidence we can share readily:
   - SOC 2 SOC-Report: summary page (redacted) and system boundaries (we do not share full reports externally without an NDA)
   - CAIQ answers: we can export the CAIQ subset (redacted PII) for Redpoint to understand controls.
   - Application logs: read-only S3 paths can be provided; we'll create a temporary, time-limited IAM role for Redpoint if they need direct access.
3) Access model: prefer that Redpoint run tests from their scanners only against public endpoints; any authenticated tests require a signed statement and scoped accounts.

I'll prepare:
- A one-pager attack-surface summary (PDF) — delivery: Monday, 2026-12-08, 11:00 PST
- A CAIQ fragment export with redactions — delivery: Monday, 2026-12-08, 17:00 PST
- Proposed temp-read-only S3 bucket role and retention notes for logs — will coordinate with Vivek.

Vivek — can you confirm the canonical S3 paths and the owner names for the API gateways and admin consoles so I can cite them in the summary? Also need an estimated patching SLA for critical findings (we typically aim for 72 hours).

Monica Patel
Head of Security Operations
